name: morphlex-security-harness
description: Repo-local security and AI red-team harness for Morphlex/Sovereign apps.

scripts.promptfoo:version: PROMPTFOO_CONFIG_DIR=.promptfoo PROMPTFOO_CACHE_PATH=.promptfoo/cache PROMPTFOO_DISABLE_TELEMETRY=1 PROMPTFOO_DISABLE_UPDATE=1 PROMPTFOO_DISABLE_SHARING=1 promptfoo --version
scripts.redteam:generate: PROMPTFOO_CONFIG_DIR=.promptfoo PROMPTFOO_CACHE_PATH=.promptfoo/cache PROMPTFOO_DISABLE_TELEMETRY=1 PROMPTFOO_DISABLE_UPDATE=1 PROMPTFOO_DISABLE_SHARING=1 promptfoo redteam generate -c security/promptfoo/promptfooconfig.yaml
scripts.redteam:run: PROMPTFOO_CONFIG_DIR=.promptfoo PROMPTFOO_CACHE_PATH=.promptfoo/cache PROMPTFOO_DISABLE_TELEMETRY=1 PROMPTFOO_DISABLE_UPDATE=1 PROMPTFOO_DISABLE_SHARING=1 promptfoo redteam run -c security/promptfoo/promptfooconfig.yaml
scripts.redteam:eval: PROMPTFOO_CONFIG_DIR=.promptfoo PROMPTFOO_CACHE_PATH=.promptfoo/cache PROMPTFOO_DISABLE_TELEMETRY=1 PROMPTFOO_DISABLE_UPDATE=1 PROMPTFOO_DISABLE_SHARING=1 promptfoo eval -c security/promptfoo/promptfooconfig.yaml
